Firecrawl's $75M Series B was led by Smash Capital (Smash Ventures in some reports). Sources say the round also drew Y Combinator, Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Freestyle, and Offline Ventures. Coverage dates the announcement to September 22, 2026, alongside the launch of its Alexandria data platform. No valuation was disclosed.

Sources differ on some details:
- **Series A amount:** One source puts it at $20.7M, another at $14.5M.
- **Headquarters:** One profile lists San Francisco, while another describes Los Angeles-based Smash.
- **Founding year:** One profile says 2022, while others say 2024.
- **SEC filing:** RuntimeWire reports a Form D showing about $82M in preferred stock sold, which is higher than the announced $75M, and says neither disclosure explains the gap.

content.text:
Firecrawl raised **$75M** in its Series B. **Smash Capital** led the round, though some outlets call the firm Smash Ventures. Alongside the round, Firecrawl announced **Alexandria**, a data platform and "knowledge library" for AI agents.

Coverage dates the announcement to September 22, 2026. Other investors named include Y Combinator, Altos Ventures, Nexus Venture Partners, Freestyle and Offline Ventures. No valuation was disclosed.

RuntimeWire reports an SEC Form D showing about $82M in preferred stock sold, which is more than the announced $75M. It says neither disclosure explains the gap.

I only ran one search and read the result snippets, not the full articles. I haven't checked the figures against Firecrawl's own announcement.

Sources:
- [Web-Scraping Firm Firecrawl Raises $75M Series B Led by Smash Ventures](https://aiweekly.co/alerts/web-scraping-firm-firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-led-by-smash-ventures-for-ai)
- [Dealroom: Firecrawl raises $75M Series B to build a knowledge library for AI agents](https://dealroom.co/news/155341-firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-to-build-a-knowledge-library-for-ai-agents/)
- [RuntimeWire: Firecrawl raises $75M to turn web crawling into an agent data library](https://runtimewire.com/article/firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-alexandria-ai-agent-data)

- [Inforcapital: Firecrawl raises $75M Series B, launches Alexandria](https://inforcapital.com/news/firecrawl-raises-75m-series-b-launches-alexandria/)
